Tomorrow's count on "Billion" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
762.headline: How prizes are split

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has 286,317 prizes of $100 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $1 million prize, with three left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

847.body:
All the top prizes on "Bingo 50X" have been claimed. That lowers the biggest prize from $500,000 to $100,000. There are two of those left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Everything here about "Bingo 50X" comes from official Ohio lottery numbers, current through November 5.
847.headline: All four top prizes claimed

891.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Cash Explosion 25X", only a small slice are still unsold. The game is near the end of its run, with two of ten top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Everything above about "Cash Explosion 25X" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
891.headline: Where this game is in its run
